title: Oil — Filter Housing — Extension of the Drain Nozzle Change to the Higher Rated Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Extends the bayonet drain nozzle and closed shroud change to the higher rated installation, where the shroud clearance to the cowl differs and a shorter hose is required.

sections.planning_reason: The original drain bulletin was written for the lower rated installation and its shroud fouls the cowl on the higher rated engine at the closed position, which two operators found during embodiment. Rather than restrict the original bulletin, this one covers the higher rated installation with the correct shroud clearance and the shorter drain hose that the tighter cowl line requires.
sections.description: This bulletin fits the same bayonet drain nozzle and a closed shroud with the clearance profile suited to the higher rated cowl, together with the current washer standard at the housing joint. The nozzle, filter element and housing are otherwise identical to the original bulletin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl and make the engine safe for oil system work. Drain the housing and remove the filter element following AMM-M-79-20-12-600-048-A. Remove the drain nozzle and the open shroud and clean the joint faces. Install the current washer and the bayonet nozzle, torque as specified, then install the clearance profile shroud supplied with this bulletin, which is not interchangeable with the shroud in the original kit. Check the clearance to the cowl at the closed position at three points and confirm eight millimetres minimum. Refit the element, replenish, do the leak check at idle and at take-off power and close the cowl.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-46 aircraft with the higher rated installation, delivered before MSN M00377. Aircraft that have already accomplished MRD-79-1010 with the original shroud must have that shroud replaced under this bulletin; the two shrouds are not interchangeable and the original will foul at the closed position.
sections.material_note: Kit is per engine and contains the bayonet nozzle, the clearance profile shroud, the washer and the shorter drain hose. Revision two corrects the drain hose part call-out, which in the first issue quoted the longer hose from the original bulletin.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next filter element change on the higher rated installation.

tooling: Drain hose, short, with bayonet fitting

revision_history.reason: Drain hose part call-out corrected; clearance check added as step 6
